description: Live sports from SofaScore. Without an event ID: every match in play for a sport (football, basketball, tennis, ice-hockey, baseball, cricket, esports...) with event ID, competition, teams, live score and status. With an event ID: score by period, venue, incidents (goals, cards, substitutions with minute), live and pre-match odds by market, and team statistics (possession, xG, shots...). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
